submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE final independent traditional Chinese festival event banner for the Taoist fantasy game 五行奇谈.
Canvas: target native 2098 × 749 pixels, very wide landscape 2.8:1, opaque edge-to-edge illustration. Never a whole interface or a contact sheet.
Input image 1 is the PRIMARY approved style, chibi-character and horizontal-composition reference. Input image 2 is the approved mail interface context; use its painting quality only, never copy UI frames, borders, controls or writing.
Preserve the reference's refined rounded Chinese hand-painted fantasy art: precise polished contours, full rounded shapes, rich but restrained painterly detail, convincing cloth/stone/foliage volumes, jade and teal landscape, ivory cloth, warm gold accents, clean air and soft depth. Luminous but properly exposed highlights. Premium 2D illustration, not flat vector or plastic 3D.
Character on the RIGHT THIRD: one small chibi Taoist boy, the same large brown eyes, rosy round face, short spiky brown hair, golden headband with knot and two ribbons, jade-green gold-trim vest over ivory robe and trousers, golden yin-yang gourd on belt. Big head and short limbs. Keep his face, hands and all important props within safe edges.
LEFT 45% stays comparatively quiet: softly layered distant scenery and mist or sky, suitable for future overlaid text, but do not paint any text. Foreground thematic props concentrate on the right. Do not place the character on the left.
ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: no Chinese or English characters, pseudo-writing, numerals, calligraphy, watermark, logo, UI border, graphic frame. Plain lanterns and plain packets must have NO characters. No giant moon, mooncakes, rabbit or Mid-Autumn osmanthus. Change the scene to the festival below instead of copying the reference night setting.
Rendering goal: highest available refined finished painting; the host manages the model and quality.
Festival-specific scene: Theme: Xiayuan festival (下元), peaceful late-autumn water blessings. Clear cool pale-blue morning light with warm sunrise edging autumn reeds, quiet reflective stream and misty teal mountain shrine on the left. On the right the boy stands on safe stone steps beside a small jade-green water basin, holding one delicate unlit lotus-shaped floating lantern with a plain gold center; a few similar tiny lotus lanterns rest near reeds on the water. A small blue-and-gold ornamental water-wave medallion beside his yin-yang gourd, sparse golden ginkgo leaves. Gentle water-blessing scene distinct from a night festival: bright daytime, clean and serene. No writing, ghosts, horror or funeral paper.

submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Make ONE polished final refinement of the Xiayuan daytime water-blessing banner. Target native canvas 2098 x 749 pixels, opaque full-bleed, 2.8:1.
Input image 1 = approved PRIMARY painting, character identity and wide-composition reference (Mid-Autumn). Input image 2 = approved mail UI PAINTING QUALITY ONLY, no interface elements. Input image 3 = current Xiayuan candidate to refine.
Preserve image 3's refined rounded Chinese hand-painted detail, cool clean morning palette, warm sunlight, jade-green water basin, right-side stone steps, ginkgo accents, gold-ribbon brown-haired chibi Taoist boy, ivory clothes, jade vest, gold yin-yang gourd and blue/gold water-wave medallion. Keep a single boy in the RIGHT THIRD, large round brown eyes, rosy face, short body and short limbs. Preserve the lovely quality of his face and cloth rendering.
Correct these three execution errors in image 3:
1. The boy must be STANDING calmly and securely upright on the broad stone step, not sitting, crouching or kneeling. Both short legs and both small shoes are visible, anatomically distinct, with their soles in contact with the same dry step. Keep his full hair and shoes inside safe margins. Natural simple two-handed pose supporting the lotus lantern from below, two hands, five fingers per hand with believable occlusion; no extra fingers, duplicated hands or detached grip.
2. His lotus-shaped floating lantern must be UNLIT, with a plain matte gold center. No flame, no burning wick, no glowing inner light, no radiant halo. A few tiny floating lotus lanterns close to the reeds must also be unlit. They are delicate crafted lotus water lanterns, not growing flowers on tall stems. No writing on any object.
3. LEFT 45 PERCENT must become quiet open reflective stream and pale layered mist with only a very small distant teal-roof shrine and soft low-contrast mountain silhouettes. Remove dense nearby left-side reed clusters, bridges and the many sharp detailed temples/mountains in that area. Keep the distant setting readable but deliberately lower its detail and contrast to allow future text overlay. The water and mist should have gentle blue-green tone, not flat white overexposure. Keep foreground thematic details concentrated on the right.
Retain morning daylight, small warm sunrise near center-right, sparse golden ginkgo and late-autumn/early-winter dry reeds. Crisp controlled highlights and ivory fabric fold detail. Premium 2D hand-painted volume, never plastic 3D or flat vector.
ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, pseudo-writing, numerals, watermark, logo, decorative frame, UI border or panel. No giant moon, rabbit, mooncake, ghosts, horror or funeral paper. One independent horizontal illustration only.
